title: ck ll ff ss · j v w x · y z qu
cando: read every single letter of the alphabet

about.text: In this lesson you learn the sounds ck, ll, ff, ss, j, v, w, x, y, z, zz, qu. You hear each sound, you write its letters, and then you read words and a short text with them.
goals: Say the sound each new letter makes
Join sounds together to read a word
Break a word into sounds to write it
Read the new words out loud

chapters.title: Double Letters: ck ll ff ss
chapters.text:
This is Lesson 5. Something changes today.
Until now, one letter was one sound.
That stops being true here.
Listen to the word sack.
sss. a. k. Three sounds.
Now look at it. S. A. C. K.
Four letters. Three sounds.
The c and the k are one sound together.
We write ck. We say k.
Say it with me. ck. Just k.
Not see-kay. Just k.
There are three more like this.
ll. Two letters. One sound. lll.
ff. Two letters. One sound. fff.
ss. Two letters. One sound. sss.
Say them with me. ck. ll. ff. ss.
They all come at the END of a word.
Sack. Hill. Puff. Miss.
Now blend one. sss. a. ck. Sack.
Three sounds, not four.
Another. h. i. ll. Hill.
Count the sounds, not the letters.
That is the lesson today.
Three tricky words. Was. Has. As.

chapters.title: j v w x
chapters.text:
Four more letters.
These four are less common. You still need them.
First. j. Say it with me. j. j.
Next. vvv. Teeth on your lip.
Say it with me. vvv. Feel it buzz.
Now fff. No buzz. Only air.
vvv buzzes. fff does not.
Feel your throat with your hand. Say vvv.
Next. w. Round your lips. w.
Say it with me. w. w.
Last. x. This one is strange.
x is two sounds, not one.
Listen. Box. b. o. ks.
The x says k and s together.
Say it with me. ks. ks.
Not eks. That is the name. Say ks.
Now join them.
j. u. g. Jug.
v. a. nnn. Van.
b. o. ks. Box.
Three tricky words. You. Your. Are.
You and your look alike. Read to the end.

chapters.title: y z zz qu
chapters.text:
The last single letters.
First. y. Say it with me. y. y.
Next. zzz. Like sss, but with a buzz.
Say sss. Now say zzz.
Hand on your throat. sss. Nothing.
zzz. It buzzes.
And zz at the end is the same sound.
Buzz. b. u. zzz. Three sounds.
Last. qu. These two always go together.
In English, q is never alone.
It always has a u after it.
qu says kw. Listen. Quiz. kw. i. zzz.
Say it with me. qu. qu.
Now stop. You have all 26 letters.
Every single letter in English.
From here on, letters work in pairs.
Two letters making one new sound.
You met four already. ck. ll. ff. ss.
There are more in Lesson 8.
Three tricky words. They. Said. One.
Said and one break every rule. Learn them by sight.
The alphabet is finished.

sounds.about: Two letters, one sound: k. It comes at the end.
A sound made with the tongue and voice. j.
Teeth on your lip, with voice. vvv.
Round your lips and push. w.
Two sounds together at the end: k and s.
A sound at the start of a word. y.
A buzz, like s with voice. zzz.
Two letters that always travel together. qu.

reader.title: Up the Hill
reader.text:
Dad has a sack.
The sack is big.
It is a hot hill.
Dad had to sit.
He had a bit of his bun.
The sack fell off.
Dad got it back.

canDo: I can say the sounds ck, ll, ff, ss, j, v.
I can read words like sack and hill.
I can write a word from its sounds.
I can read a short text out loud.
